description: A craftsman-style residential front entry porch shot from outside at street level. The home exterior features warm khaki-tan lap siding with crisp white trim boards and two square tapered white columns rising from brick-base pedestals. A gabled portico roof with vertical tongue-and-groove shiplap ceiling spans the entry in a peaked triangle. The front door is a rich dark mahogany stained wood with four raised panels and a transom of small divided lights above. Bluestone or concrete step treads with brick risers lead up to the porch landing. A black and white narrow striped doormat lays flat at the threshold. On either side of the door, a round black planter holds a lush mixed arrangement of soft pink, purple, yellow, and white flowers. Flanking Japanese maple trees frame the composition on both sides with vivid crimson-red autumn foliage, their branches reaching into the upper frame. The sky is overcast, casting flat even autumn light across the facade. A warm amber glow emanates from beneath the portico ceiling above the door, creating a welcoming focal point. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting with a normal lens from directly in front of the entry in a centered symmetrical composition. The full porch, door, and flanking trees are visible, giving a classic wide establishing view of the entry.
